safety.title: Is It Safe to Buy Instagram Services **Through an SMM Panel?**
safety.body:
Using a reputable Instagram SMM panel like SMMGen carries minimal risk when you follow a few basic practices.

SMMGen never asks for your Instagram password. Every service uses only your public profile or post URL. Your account access is never at risk. Instagram does not ban accounts for gaining followers or likes. The platform acts against accounts using unauthorized third-party login access or violating community standards. Because SMMGen uses zero login access, that category of risk does not apply.

The main factor to manage is delivery speed and volume. Ordering 50,000 followers overnight on a new account with 50 existing followers looks unnatural. Order in realistic increments and use drip-feed delivery where available to spread delivery across several days.

For full details on SMMGen's security practices and track record since 2018, visit our about us page.
